categoryBreakdown.note: IN_SAMPLE = at least one of the 38 compiled candidates covers this claim's source location, so the full CREDIT/NO_CREDIT standard applies. DISCOVERED_NOT_SAMPLED = the full 887-candidate discovery population found a candidate at/near this claim's section, but it was outside the 38 the AI-Gateway cost ceiling allowed Headroom to compile -- a sampling exclusion, NOT a Headroom failure to notice. criticalMaterialClaimDiscoveryRecall.definition: Same, restricted to the 54 CRITICAL GT claims only.

materialSubstantiveCreditRate.definition: Among category-A MATERIAL+CRITICAL claims (13 of the 14), fraction receiving CREDIT (compiled IR content correctly represents the specific claim: action, object, scope, amount/threshold, conditions, exceptions).

criticalSubstantiveCreditRate.definition: Same, restricted to category-A CRITICAL claims only (5 of the 14).

operativeStateCheck.rootCause: stage5-amendment-effects.json shows the package-graph layer detected both restatement events (doc-b RESTATE_AGREEMENT effective 2025-05-19, and doc-c RESTATE_AGREEMENT effective 2026-04-21) but could not resolve which document each one targets: both effects carry status REVIEW_REQUIRED, confidence 0.3, and unresolvedReason 'This document is classified as a full amendment-and-restatement, but its own restated target document could not be resolved.' Because the restatement targets never resolved, the downstream operative-state computation tracked zero amended provisions and never designated any document (doc-a, doc-b, or doc-c) as currently operative.
operativeStateCheck.verdict: INCORRECT / UNRESOLVED. Headroom's structured operative-state pipeline stage did NOT correctly identify doc-c as operative -- it produced an empty, non-committal result rather than either the right answer or a wrong one. This is a genuine PACKAGE_GRAPH-layer failure (restatement target-document resolution), independent of and upstream from the discovery/compilation/verification metrics above. Note this failure is a safe failure in the sense that it did not assert a wrong operative document with false confidence -- it asserted nothing -- but it also means no downstream consumer of stage5-operative-state.json could correctly determine which of the three agreements currently governs the facility without falling back to reading stage3's document classifications/identities or the raw documents directly.
